notes.title: NEW UPDATE v1.1.0
notes.content:
Updates/Changes


 New normal difficulty added
 New leaderboard for normal difficulty
 Now manas fall if they are too high


Minor Fix

 Leaderboard menu sometimes only loads on the second click
 Skeletons that sometimes look stuck
 Skill charge in the crosshairs sometimes got stuck
 Tutorial page opening without being close

notes.title: Changes and Adjustments
notes.content:
In-game tutorial page change with all control information
 Change to the game initialize in the native language corresponding to the available translations
 Changed the options menu within the game to be separated by type of option (for new options that can be added in the future)
 Added new mouse options
 Added warning for when there is not enough mana to cast ability
